info.name: CareLayer API
info.description: CareLayer backend (apps/api). Contract: docs/API_CONTRACT.md (v1). One folder per module; folders are added by the task that builds each module (Z3 Auth, Z5 Top-up, Z6 Chat + Questions, Z7 Nurse cases, Z9 Nurse profile + Admin). Select the 'CareLayer local' environment ({{baseUrl}} = http://localhost:4000).

request.description: Uses the cl_refresh cookie (no body, no bearer). Returns a new access token and rotates the cookie. Reusing an old cookie more than 10 s later revokes the session (401 REFRESH_REUSED).

request.description: Live sessions for this user (one per device). `current` marks this one. DELETE /auth/sessions/:id ends another.
Ends this session immediately and clears the cookie. Also works with only the cookie (expired access token). Idempotent. POST /auth/logout-all ends every session.

Her custodial Stellar testnet wallet. status: pending (not on-chain yet) | active. Balance read live from Stellar (4 s limit); if Stellar is slow, the last known balance with balanceSyncedAt. freeAnswersRemaining is null for nurses. Sign in first (Auth folder).
Confirmed money movements, newest first. Women: top-ups (+), answers paid from her wallet (-). Nurses: earnings (+), withdrawals (-). Amounts out are negative on both kobo and usdc.
Women only. ₦2,000 = 200000 kobo (limits ₦100 to ₦100,000). Open `authorizationUrl` in a browser and pay with a Paystack TEST card. Saves topupId and topupReference to the environment.
Checks Paystack and Stellar before answering: pending -> paid -> credited (or failed). Poll every 2-3 s after paying.

exec: if (!secret) throw new Error('Set the paystackSecretKey environment variable (your sk_test_ key)');

request.description: Simulates Paystack's charge.success webhook for the last top-up. Set the SECRET environment variable `paystackSecretKey` (your sk_test_ key, never exported); the pre-request script signs the exact body with HMAC-SHA512 like Paystack does. amount must equal the top-up's amountKobo, else the top-up fails as amount_mismatch.

Woman only. Stateless: send the whole thread (oldest first, last turn = hers). Returns { kind: "reply", message, escalationOffer } or an EmergencyResponse. Red flags are checked before the LLM. About 6-10 s on the NVIDIA free tier. 12 requests/min per woman. Contract §7.
